_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Praise the Lord from the heights; praise him, all you stars.
Let all creation sing.
The child who shares our flesh and blood is here.
He carries us as he was carried.
Even into Egypt, even through the night.
God goes with the ones who flee.
Come, let us worship the God who shares our days.
Thanks be to God. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Praise him from the heights, sun and moon and shining stars — and praise him, too, down here, where a family bundles a child and runs for the border in the dark.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
This is the God who lifts us up and carries us, the way that mother carried her son all the long road into Egypt.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
He took on our flesh and blood, our hunger and our fear, so that he could stand beside us when we are tested.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us.
So bring your griefs and your gladness alike; the One who shared our days has not let go of us.
The Word became flesh and dwells among us. Thanks be to God!
